beats.text: [amused, conversational] At nine in the morning, King Bernard declared war on a pigeon. A bold strategic move. The pigeon had, admittedly, been sitting on his statue.
[amused disbelief] This is an insult to the crown!
So he sent twelve soldiers, three advisers, and a man whose only job was carrying a very impressive flag.
The pigeon had <stress>no flag</stress>. Frankly, things looked bad.
The soldiers charged. The crowd cheered. The pigeon moved six inches to the left.
By lunchtime, the army had broken a ladder, lost a helmet, and accidentally arrested the royal gardener. Naturally, the king announced a magnificent victory.
The pigeon was unavailable for comment. [pause] It was busy sitting on his other statue.
